nodes.label: Brensan KiCad DB User Manual (Kullanici Kitapcigi, 19 Ekim 2026, Surum 2)
nodes.description: 31-page Turkish user manual of the Brensan KiCad Database Library desktop app; sections: Malzeme Tanimi (KiCad), Product Tree, Analiz ve Yonetim. Screenshots taken from a sample-data run.

nodes.label: Brensan KiCad Database Library (application)
nodes.description: Tkinter desktop app managing the SQLite component database that KiCad reads over ODBC as a database library.

nodes.label: Typical workflow: define component -> verify with DigiKey -> Product Tree project/card -> Add Card Revision -> Add BOM -> check matches -> Approve BOM -> Export BOM
Login window (username/password, exits after five failed attempts)
First Administrator Account window
nodes.description: Shown when the Users table is empty; this admin then adds other accounts in Settings > Users.

nodes.label: Settings window (Ayarlar)
nodes.description: Opened from the Settings button top-right of the main window; tabs Database, DigiKey API, LCSC, Users, Change history, My account.

nodes.label: Settings > Database tab
nodes.description: Shows active SQLite file, backup folder, log file and the Back up now button.

nodes.label: Back up now button
Daily automatic database backup (_dbBackup, BrensanDB_YYYY-MM-DD.sqlite, last 10 kept)
nodes.rationale: Backup is taken on first start of each day so a bad bulk import or update can be rolled back by copying the dated file back as BrensanDB.sqlite; db_backup_keep changes the retention.

nodes.label: settings.json (database_path, symbol_library_dir, db_backup_keep)
BrensanDB.sqlite (shared copy Z:\Muhendislik\Kicad\BrensanDB.sqlite)
nodes.rationale: KiCad's ODBC data source and the app must point at the same file; the manual tells users to confirm the Database row before editing.

nodes.label: BrensanDB.kicad_dbl (each component table registered as a KiCad library)
KiCad ODBC database library connection
Main window / Malzeme tanim ekrani (toolbar, Record form left, action buttons centre, Records list right, status bar)
nodes.description: Screenshot p4: top toolbar with Table, Search, DigiKey, LCSC, Export UD BR, Check BOM List, Purchasing, Update Brensan Stock, Product Tree, Obsolete Products, Settings; left Record form; centre New/Clear, Save, Update, Delete plus Brensan Stock, Stock QTY, Unit Price, Product Status, Comment, Alternate Part Number; right Records treeview; bottom status bar with user and role.

nodes.label: Table selector and Refresh tables
nodes.description: Picks the component category (Resistor, Capacitor, IC, Connector...). Refresh tables re-reads table list from the database.

nodes.label: Search field and button (all tables, all columns, '+' AND tokens)
nodes.description: Example queries RMCF0603FT10K0, BR-16-103-601, '10k + 0603 + yageo'. First result column shows the source table; selecting a row from another category switches Table automatically.

nodes.label: Record form (auto-generated from the selected table's columns)
Component Type field (record's table; changing it + Update moves the record)
Move record to another table (Component Type + Update, confirm, common columns copied, source deleted, Created at/by preserved)
Records list (sortable headers, draggable column widths remembered per table)
Status bar (last result, component count, logged-in user, progress bar and Cancel for long jobs)
New / Clear form button
Save button (insert new record; empty form cannot be saved)
Update button (no write when nothing changed)
Delete button (confirms; whole deleted row kept in change history)
Reference designator field (R, C, U...; supplier lookup fills table default when empty)
Value field in KiCad format (10KΩ, 10µF, 4.7µH)
Brensan_Part_Number (BR code; '-' when not yet assigned)
Minimum main window size 1000x600 px
nodes.rationale: A hidden button does not mean the feature was removed; widen the window.

nodes.label: Symbols label -> Symbol suggestions window
nodes.description: Reads Brensan_<Table>.kicad_sym from the Symbols folder, lists Library:Symbol entries with a filter box, Select / double-click writes the name into the Symbols field; falls back to a default such as Brensan_Resistor:R when the file is missing.

nodes.label: Symbols folder with Brensan_<Table>.kicad_sym files
nodes.description: Searched next to the exe or one level up (KiCad library root); override with symbol_library_dir in settings.json; status bar prints the path searched.

nodes.label: Datasheet label (opens link in default browser)
nodes.rationale: Verify pin count, body size and pad layout from the datasheet before choosing a footprint.

nodes.label: Footprints label -> Footprint suggestions window
nodes.description: Screenshot p8: 0603 in a Resistor description resolved directly to R_0603_1608Metric. Buttons Open source, Apply selected footprint, Select library folder. Suggestions are never applied automatically.
nodes.rationale: Local installed KiCad library first so no network is used when the package is already known; web results are tagged 'Verification required'; the list is not an electrical/mechanical approval.

nodes.label: Table -> KiCad footprint library mapping (Resistor->Resistor_SMD, Capacitor->Capacitor_SMD, Inductor->Inductor_SMD, Diode->Diode_SMD or LED_SMD, Fuse->Fuse; HandSolder variants ranked lower)
Footprint web search fallback (MPN query patterns; Google Programmable Search, else DuckDuckGo and Bing; DigiKey queried once if package still unknown)
Select library folder (KiCad footprints or .pretty folder; auto-scans Program Files, user profile KiCad installs newest first, and company Footprints.pretty)
Description / Package fields drive footprint suggestions (0402, 0603, 0805, 1206, SOT-23-5, SOIC-8, LQFP-48 7x7mm)
Verified field (green Verified / red NOT Verified; admin only)
nodes.rationale: Marks the component as checked and ready for KiCad; only admins set it and only admins may update, move or delete a verified record. Action buttons are disabled for non-admins when a verified record is selected.

nodes.label: Comment field (free note, active users)
Alternate Part Number field
nodes.rationale: Shown by Obsolete Products and project recommendations; when empty for an obsolete part the app warns that an alternative must be researched. An alternative name is not an automatic design change or change approval.

nodes.label: Brensan_Stock field (company stock, written only by stock queries, not editable)
Product Status field (Active, Obsolete, Not For New Designs, Last Time Buy; from DigiKey or manual)
nodes.rationale: An empty Product Status is not evidence the part is Active; repeat DigiKey lookups regularly for critical parts.

nodes.label: Created at/by and Modified at/by tracking fields (read-only, written by the program)
nodes.description: Older records predating the tracking columns have empty Created/Modified values; Modified fills on the first change.

nodes.label: Change_Log table (old and new values for every insert, update, delete, move, stock update, BOM and project action)
Brensan_Kicad_DB.log file and rotated archives
Settings > Change history tab (Source: Database or Log files; Day and Search filters; 250-row pages; Details pane; Selected record history)
DigiKey button (official API lookup of one MPN into the form)
nodes.description: Uses Search field first, else Manufacturer_Part_Number; runs in background; fills manufacturer, MPN, description, package, datasheet, value, Product Status; warns when status is not Active.

nodes.label: LCSC button (HTML page scraping lookup of one MPN)
nodes.rationale: LCSC has no official API, so the lookup reads the web page and can break when the page layout changes; warns when status is not Available.

nodes.label: KiCad value formatting of supplier data (10 KOhms -> 10KΩ)
Stock QTY and Unit Price taken from Cut Tape / Digi-Reel packaging
Separate stock sources: Brensan Stock = company stock, Stock QTY / Unit Price = supplier
Update Brensan Stock button (bulk stock and missing-BR fill from the company stock server)
nodes.description: Queries every component with a BR code once and writes Brensan_Stock; fills missing BR codes only on a unique exact MPN (+manufacturer) match; background job with percentage progress and Cancel; result window counts updated / not found / skipped / permission-required rows. Logged as STOCK_UPDATE without touching Modified fields.
nodes.rationale: Stops at the first error when the server is unreachable and keeps old values, so an offline server is never read as zero stock.

nodes.label: Company stock server stokbul.php (http://192.168.1.184/stokbul.php)
Automatic stock refresh of the selected record ('-' = not yet queried, 0 = real zero)
Check BOM List (enrich an Excel BOM with DigiKey price tiers, Part Status, Digikey Stock and Brensan Stock QTY)
nodes.description: Picks .xlsx/.xls, finds the MPN column automatically (Manufacturer Part Number, MPN, Part Number...), never uses the Brensan Part Number column for lookup; adds Price, Part Status, Digikey Stock, 1/10/100/250/500/1000 pcs unit prices and Brensan Stock QTY; output <file>_DigiKey_Updated.xlsx next to the source, source unchanged; Not Found / Error: markers.
nodes.rationale: Different job from Product Tree > Add BOM: Check BOM List processes a file with supplier data, Add BOM stores a BOM into a card revision.

nodes.label: Supplier circuit breaker (3 consecutive connection failures -> remaining rows 'Error: DigiKey unreachable'; stock server stops after first failure)
<file>_DigiKey_Updated.xlsx output workbook
Purchasing window (Browse BOM, Requested by, Project, date, Board quantity / multiplier, Starting row number, Create purchasing list)
nodes.description: BOM must have Brensan Part Number, Description, Manufacturer, Manufacturer Part Number and Quantity headers; output written in the BOM folder with overwrite confirmation.

nodes.label: Export UD BR (collects components without BR code -> Brensan Part Numbers.xlsx list and Brensan Part Number Request.xlsx form)
nodes.rationale: Reloading BR codes from Excel was removed; assigned BR codes come back via Update Brensan Stock (unique MPN match in the stock system) or Product Tree > Sync Database.

nodes.label: Part Number Request template workbook (must sit next to the exe; list still produced when template missing)
Product Tree window (tree left, content right, draggable splitter, toolbar)
nodes.description: Toolbar: New project, New sub-project, Edit, Delete, New card, Add Card Revision, Add BOM, Edit BOM, Approve BOM, Return to Draft, Sync Database, Compare revisions, Export BOM, Project Import, Where used?, Obsolete Products. Grey button = no permission for the selected level or role. Lifecycle-risk rows highlighted light red. Ctrl/Shift multi-select, Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C tab-separated copy.

nodes.label: Project -> Subproject -> Card -> Revision hierarchy (max two project levels; '(current)' marks the current link in the selected project)
Production / Development label from project code suffix (-A/-B Production, -X/-X1/-X2 Development; stored code unchanged)
New project / New sub-project window (Parent project, Project code, Project name, Description, Project folder Browse, Save)
nodes.description: Top-level codes unique among themselves, sub-project codes unique within parent; folder is where Add BOM opens its file dialog and a folder icon opens Explorer; files are never moved or copied. Edit keeps card links; Delete needs admin and removes only the project record and its links. Logged as PROJECT_CREATE / PROJECT_UPDATE / PROJECT_DELETE.

nodes.label: New card window (Board part number, Board name, Revision, Boards / project, Create card)
nodes.description: First revision created as an empty Draft; same physical card must use the same part number in every project; same number cannot be reused with a different name. Edit card changes number and name; admin needed when the card has an approved BOM.

nodes.label: Link saved card (New card -> Link saved card: reuse a card revision in another project)
Shared BOM, project-local quantity
nodes.rationale: A revision's BOM is identical in every project that uses it, so a content change in one project shows in all; only Boards / project and the current link belong to the project.

nodes.label: Boards / project quantity (per project link)
Current revision link per project
Add Card Revision (new revision code e.g. -X2 or -B; opens as empty Draft BOM and becomes current in the selected project)
nodes.description: Card number and name are read-only here; same revision name cannot be reused on a card; old BOM is not copied automatically; active users may add even when the previous BOM is approved.

nodes.label: Revision ordering rule (-B > -A > -X10 > -X2 > -X1; final letter revisions beat prototypes)
nodes.rationale: Project overview uses this to pick the newest linked revision per card; Export BOM instead starts from the current links, which explains differing totals.

nodes.label: Add BOM (import BOM_Template.xlsx workbook into the selected card revision)
nodes.description: Select the revision explicitly (card selected -> current revision); sheet picker for multi-sheet files; headers recognised in first row, no mapping form; leading '>' stripped from references; '-' in BR treated as empty; each row matched first by BR, then manufacturer + MPN, multiple candidates never auto-selected; each row needs quantity and at least BR or MPN; replacing a filled BOM asks confirmation; approved BOM only by admin, approval kept; stores source file name, date and user; cancelled, invalid or stale imports change nothing.

nodes.label: BOM_Template.xlsx (Reference, Brensan Part Number, Manufacturer, Manufacturer Part Number, Description, Quantity)
Edit BOM window (Add row, Remove rows, Edit row, Update match, Clear match, Save BOM, BOM description + Save description)
nodes.description: Save BOM is rejected when someone else changed the BOM meanwhile; logged as BOM_EDIT; Draft editable by active users, Approved only by admin and editing does not remove approval.

nodes.label: Edit row dialog (BR, MPN, Manufacturer, multi-line Description, Quantity, References, Apply row)
nodes.rationale: Identity field changes recompute the match; quantity/reference changes keep a manual match.

nodes.label: Update match / Match selected component window (find candidate by BR or MPN, confirm manufacturer and MPN)
nodes.rationale: Do not use an alternative product in place of an identity match; matching updates the usage relation for all projects using the revision and is allowed on approved BOMs.

nodes.label: Sync Database (fill missing BR codes in BOM lines from the component database)
nodes.description: Project selected -> all linked revisions in the subtree incl. previous; revision selected -> that BOM only. Uses existing match, else unique exact MPN (+manufacturer). Existing BRs preserved, ambiguous skipped and reported, approved BOMs skipped for non-admins. Single database transaction: on error nothing changes.
nodes.rationale: If the component database itself lacks the BR code, first run Update Brensan Stock, then Sync Database to push it into BOMs.

nodes.label: Approve BOM (admin; empty BOM cannot be approved; approver and time stored on revision and in change history; applies to all projects using the revision)
Return to Draft (admin; withdraws approval, keeps content, source and links, clears approver)
BOM status Draft / Approved
nodes.rationale: BOM approval and the component Verified flag are different controls. Content edits, matching, description and Sync Database never remove approval; only Return to Draft does.

nodes.label: Delete in Product Tree (revision -> only that project link; card -> card's links in the project; BOM rows purged when last link removed; parent with sub-projects must be emptied first)
Permission matrix (active user vs administrator) rechecked inside each transaction
nodes.rationale: Admin: verify components, edit verified records, approve BOMs, change approved BOMs, delete projects, API and user management. Active user: add/edit/delete unverified components and Draft BOMs, search, BOM, purchasing, stock queries, define projects and cards. Role and active flag are re-read from the database during the operation so a revoked user is stopped immediately.

nodes.label: Stale edit / preview rejection (optimistic concurrency)
nodes.rationale: Save BOM, Add BOM and Project Import are refused when the BOM, file or database changed between preview and commit; the user must reopen or re-preview.

nodes.label: Project overview panel (summary counters, analysis tabs, Project materials filter, Cards / BOMs, Recommendations, Refresh)
nodes.description: Counters All materials, Obsolete, Lifecycle risk, Critical (IC / MOSFET), Stock shortages, Unmatched filter the list; risky rows light red, stock shortage yellow, unmatched grey. Counts are distinct products; Quantity / project = BOM qty x board count; stock comparison is per project without reservations; unknown stock not counted as shortage; computed in background, never changes BOMs.

nodes.label: Critical materials filter (IC, MCU, Mosfet tables only; R, L, C excluded)
Recommendations tab (risky parts without alternative, stock shortages, unknown stock/status, unmatched rows, empty BOMs, Drafts to review)
Cards / BOMs tab (newest revisions, double-click opens BOM)
Compare revisions window (From / To, Compare, Added / Removed / Changed, details pane, Export comparison to Excel)
nodes.description: Needs at least two saved revisions of the same card; covers quantity, references, source part data, database match, BOM description and approval status; pure reordering is not a difference; ambiguous duplicate rows are shown as add/remove, never guessed.
nodes.rationale: Comparison uses saved revisions; editing a BOM inside a revision does not keep the previous content, so open a new revision when a comparison is needed.

nodes.label: Export BOM window (one row per revision with Use checkbox, project, card, revision, current, approval, board count, line count; Export selected)
nodes.description: Defaults to current revisions; Space/double-click toggles Use. Project scope -> one consolidated BOM, per-card qty x Boards / project; card scope -> each selected revision as a card. Workbook has a BOM sheet (template headers, numeric quantities, filter, frozen header) and a Cards sheet. Brensan Stock column is live DB stock, shown once for shared materials, 0 = zero, blank = unknown. Export never changes saved BOMs or current selections.

nodes.label: Project Import (whole project from Project_Import_Template.xlsx: Projects, Cards, BOM sheets with Guide; validate -> preview -> single transaction)
nodes.description: Preview shows new project, card, revision and BOM line counts; existing definitions reused; existing BOMs with different content kept and conflicts resolved in the file; Approved status import needs admin; only one revision per card per project may be Current=Yes; numeric card numbers must be text cells (001234 -> 1234 pitfall); errors carry sheet and row.

nodes.label: Project_Import_Template.xlsx (Guide, Projects, Cards, BOM sheets)

Where used? window (search BR/MPN/manufacturer; upper table component identity, Value, Description; lower table card/revision, quantities, Brensan Stock, status; Previous revisions checkbox; Refresh stock / usage; Export usage to Excel)
nodes.description: Quantity / board x Boards / project = Quantity / project; parent and sub-project are separate rows, not a rolled-up total; same stock value repeats per row, do not sum. Double-click on a BOM line opens it; double-click on a usage row opens the revision.
nodes.rationale: Refresh stock / usage only re-reads the local database; new stock from the company server needs Update Brensan Stock on the main screen.

nodes.label: Obsolete Products window (one row per BR, expandable to project/sub-project/card/revision/Current-Previous/references/quantities; Alternate Part Number next to MPN; Refresh)
nodes.description: Reachable from the main screen or Product Tree toolbar; lists all components whose Product Status is Obsolete, Not For New Designs or Last Time Buy, including ones not used in any project.

nodes.label: Obsolete statuses: Obsolete, Not For New Designs, Last Time Buy (lifecycle risk, light red highlight)
Settings > DigiKey API / Daily usage tab (id, client_id, client_secret or key cid:csecret, daily_limit 0 = unlimited, used, remaining, Blocked; New/Update/Delete, Save, Refresh usage, Show checkbox)
nodes.description: Admin-only tab; secrets masked in the list; Save writes API-Keys.json and takes effect without restart.

nodes.label: API-Keys.json (real credentials; never share in manuals, screen shares or support logs)
DigiKey key rotation and quota (daily limit or 401/403/429 -> next key, blocked key shown; usage counts real HTTP requests, resets per UTC day)
nodes.rationale: The provider's server-side quota can differ from the app's local counter, so check the active database and remaining quota before bulk queries.

nodes.label: Settings > LCSC / Daily usage tab (search URL, timeout, daily request limit; no API key; lookups return nothing once the limit is reached)
Settings > Users tab (add user: username, full name, role Administrator/User, password >= 6 chars, Must change password at first login; Update details; Set password; Active flag)
nodes.description: Usernames cannot be renamed because created/modified-by values reference them; the last active admin cannot be deleted, deactivated or demoted; passwords stored as irreversible digests invisible even to admins; deactivate instead of delete for temporary blocking.

nodes.label: Settings > My account tab (change own password)
Administrator role
Active User role

Troubleshooting table (grey button, empty Symbols list, no footprint suggestion, DigiKey token failure, stock server unreachable, BR in component but empty in BOM, project vs Excel totals differ, empty overview, import rejected, forgotten password, app closes on start)
nodes.description: Forgotten sole-admin password: clear the Users table with SQLiteStudio so the first-admin window reappears. App closing at start: check the last lines of Brensan_Kicad_DB.log.

nodes.label: Keyboard shortcuts (Enter search, Ctrl+A select all, Ctrl+C tab-separated copy, Ctrl+click/Shift multi-select, +/- expand tree, Space/double-click toggle Use, double-click BOM row -> Where used?)
Support note (record screen name, selected project/card/revision, error text and steps; never share API keys)
Component category tables (Resistor, Capacitor, IC, Connector, ...)

hyperedges.label: Component definition workflow (Record form -> Symbols / Footprints / Datasheet -> Save -> DigiKey verify)
Product Tree BOM lifecycle (New card -> Add Card Revision -> Add BOM -> Edit BOM / Update match -> Sync Database -> Approve BOM / Return to Draft -> Export BOM)
BR code round trip (Export UD BR -> Part Number Request -> stock system -> Update Brensan Stock -> Sync Database -> BOM lines)
